data.description:
## Context / Problem
Discovered while triaging breezy-hogged-mastiff, which owns `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/unclassified.args`. These 13 entries move to `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/detached-maintenance.args`, which this bug owns.

`compact_trigger.maybe_compact` (`src/rebar/_commands/compact_trigger.py:374`) and `gc_trigger.maybe_gc` (`src/rebar/_snapshot/gc_trigger.py:180`) return at once on `sys.platform == "win32"`. The docstring gives the reason as the store lock's `fcntl` import crashing a detached child, but the lock kernel now has a Windows leg (`src/rebar/_store/lock_kernel.py`, commit `035b7371de8`). The tests expect the trigger to fold inline or spawn a sweep and get no call (`assert []`, `0 == 1`).

Evidence: Windows runs on throwaway branch `tmp/w05-remeasure` with origin/main `717c50f8b33` code plus a selection-only workflow change: run 44665461131 (the 242 `unclassified.args` entries; 48 passed, 194 failed or errored) and run 44681457334 (the 194, xdist, JUnit XML with full tracebacks). Both 2026-11-19 PST.

Modules:
- `tests/unit/test_compact_trigger.py` (8)
- `tests/unit/test_snapshot_gc_trigger.py` (5)

## Approach
Re-establish whether the detached sweep and GC can run on Windows now that the lock kernel is portable. Enable them and keep the tests, or mark the tests Windows-skipped with the reason. Either way the lines leave `detached-maintenance.args`.

## Scope
Test or product code for the listed modules, plus `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/detached-maintenance.args` (remove each fixed line; delete the file and its `@` reference in `.github/workflows/test.yml` once empty).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every line removed from `detached-maintenance.args` names a test that passed in a `sweep (windows)` run on main after the fix (run id recorded in a comment).
- [ ] `detached-maintenance.args` is empty and deleted with its reference in `.github/workflows/test.yml`, or each remaining line names a test recorded on this ticket as intentionally unsupported on Windows with the reason.
data.title: Windows sweep: out-of-band compaction and snapshot GC are a no-op on Windows, so 13 trigger tests see no spawn
